scope: Authored deterministic reference, alternate and plausible incorrect policy documents; synthetic test data only.

routers.Gateway:
ip access-list standard vault-source
 permit host 192.0.2.10
exit
interface service
 ip access-group vault-source out
exit

ip access-list standard visitors
 10 deny host 192.0.2.20
 20 permit any
exit
interface service
 ip access-group visitors out
exit

ip access-list standard vault-source
 permit host 192.0.2.10
exit
interface clients
 ip access-group vault-source in
exit

omissions: Remove the service attachment: both Guest checks must fail.
Reverse the host source to Guest: Admin positives must fail, with no successful denial credit from deny-all.
plans.protected_route_attack: Remove Guest's default route or set Gateway.forwarding false; grade must reject pinned context, never count route failure as policy denial.

omissions: Remove the deny while retaining the broad permit: both TCP22 negatives fail.
Change destination-port22 into a source-port22 test: Support's source22 positive and both source50000 negatives expose the mistake.
Deny all protocols at numeric port22 is not supported grammar; denying all IP toward Portal breaks required positives.
plans.protected_route_attack: Remove Portal's default route; pinned context must reject, even if a blocked test cannot get there.

omissions: Leave Edge clients out: both Portal negatives fail.
Keep broad permit ahead of Portal deny: both Portal negatives fail.
Keep Visitor as Core's permitted source: Staff positives fail and Visitor negatives fail.
Keep Core transit binding instead of archive out: denial location and Portal positives fail.
Attach a blanket deny to Archive: Staff positive checks prevent successful denial credit.
Broaden Portal deny to all IP or TCP22 to every destination: UDP22 or ArchiveTCP22 positive guards fail.
plans.protected_route_attack: Stop Core/archive, remove Edge's Archive route, or relocate Archive's address to a router; fixed context/endpoint ownership must reject rather than convert failed delivery into policy success.
